inclusion_rule: parseable YAML frontmatter declaring BOTH name and description

tool_build.note: all tool behaviour in the paper was observed on this build; the tool vocabulary is version-conditional

known_biases: code search excludes forks and indexes default branches only
discovery is file-level, so repository inclusion probability rises with agent-file count
bands whose reported_total exceeds 1000 are truncated; see partitions.jsonl
convenience sample: supports no population estimate
notes: partitions.jsonl is the per-band query log of a stage-1 re-run on 2026-08-28 (the snapshot's second day); the original run's log was not archived. The re-run discovered 4,950 of the 4,979 archived frame repositories (99.4%) and 7,301 repositories not in the frame, so the archived frame is a subset of what the interface serves and every size band is truncated at the 1,000-result ceiling. All other fields are computed from the archived files.
